notes: Breezy is now built as a single program with Python inside: the installer needs no setup step, and FFmpeg and the AI models are downloaded the first time a feature needs them (they live in the app's data folder, so updates never remove them).
Updates for the built program: the new installer is downloaded, checked, and run quietly when you close Breezy; it starts again by itself. Existing script-based installs keep updating as before.
Releases are built automatically on GitHub.
